title: Wrong prices shown after sync
alert: 412 products showing previous day prices after the 06:00 price sync
root cause: The price feed parser read times as UTC, so the new file was treated as old
failed fixes: Re-running the sync without a fix
fix: Restored the correct price file and fixed the timezone in the parser

title: Checkout returning 503
alert: cart-service 503 Service Unavailable during the Big Sale; redis-cart used_memory 99%
root cause: Redis cart memory filled up and evicted live cart sessions while the autoscaler added pods that opened more connections
fix: Froze cart-service autoscaling, raised redis-cart maxmemory, switched eviction to volatile-lru and warmed the top 500 products

title: Product pages hanging
alert: Product pages waiting 8s on reco-service; support line 9876012345 flooded
root cause: Product pages called reco-service synchronously with no timeout
fix: Added a 300ms timeout with a circuit breaker and a static fallback list

title: Search returning no products
alert: search-api zero-result rate 71%; products alias document count far below normal
root cause: The nightly reindex failed halfway but still switched the products alias to the new index
failed fixes: Rebuilding the whole index from scratch (took 2 hours)
fix: Pointed the products alias back to the previous index and re-ran the reindex with the alias switch disabled

title: Coupons applied twice
alert: 1,280 orders received the discount twice during the weekend sale; first reported by anita.s@gmail.com
root cause: Checkout retried coupon redemption after timeouts and coupon-service had no idempotency key
fix: Added an idempotency key on order id, disabled the extra retry and reversed duplicate discounts

title: Product pages slow at sale launch
alert: Origin requests up 9x at 12:00 for the weekend sale; product page load time 7s
root cause: A full CDN purge right before the weekend sale sent all traffic to origin
fix: Stopped full purges before sales; purge changed URLs only and pre-warm the top pages
